_about: Grid placement (scripts/camp/camp_build.gd). Things are built ahead_m in front of the builder, on the grid or free; each player picks with the grid button in build mode, and the choice rides along with the build request, so the host places exactly what the player saw. On the grid: cells grid_m wide centred on grid points counted from grid_origin (a Stage C build zone can carry its own), a footprint always covering whole cells, quarter turns, and grid_view drawing the cell lines as running stitches (swatch at alpha, line_m wide, stitches_per_m with dash of each stitch drawn, fading out radius_cells from the spot, lift_m above the ground). Free: any spot (kept to free.step_m) and turns of free.turn_deg. kinds: what can be built (the next-kind button cycles the ones in the build kit, in this order), its model (data/models.json) and its footprint size [x, z] in metres before turning. A free kind (the tent pitch) is always in the kit and costs coins to put down (cost); packing it away refunds them (the cozy contract). Every other kind is crafted at the workbench (data/craft.json) into the camp's build kit (the camp board starts in a new camp's kit, data/save.json, for the players to put up where they like); putting one down takes it from the kit and packing it away puts it back. An improvement (Stage B) is what the day's dream goal saves up for and raises guests' satisfaction (data/guests.json). Nothing is built over another building, within object_gap_m of a movable thing, over scenery (blockers: model -> radius in metres), or past the camp edge (data/tuning.json carry.camp_radius_m). Each player can undo their own last undo_depth building steps; the list is cleared each night. ghost is the preview: the model dithered by fade, over a thin tile (thick_m, lifted lift_m above the ground so it shows over the model) tinted ok or blocked (palette swatches) at alpha.
